title: The segmented thumb moves the way the user likes
goal: The segmented control's thumb now glides to a new option and stops, with a slight stretch on the way and no overshoot. The user judges how that feels; if they want it changed, a runner retunes the move to their answer.
notes: Motion lives in Sources/PhotonzCore/SegmentThumbMotion.swift (SegmentThumbMorph: duration 0.3, squash 0.94, stretch at 0.45, curves (.33,0,.4,1) then (.2,0,0,1)) and docs/design/mocks/shared/components/segmented.js (the page keyframes, 300ms, efa1d36f). Keep them in lockstep. segmented-thumb-film-walk films the title bar and a panel picker and fails if the glass leaves its rail. Audit: queue/audits/2026-09-29-segmented-thumb-glide.json. The first card (stretch, squash and settle) was withdrawn: the user answered it by filing the-segmented-thumb-glides-like-a-mac-control-no.
acceptance: The user has answered the card about how the thumb moves
If the answer asks for a change, the move is retuned on the component page and in the app to match it, and segmented-thumb-film-walk and segmented-thumb-glass-walk still pass at Next defaults
